input.text:
tok 1.0 "Office Supply Request"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane emp "Employee"
    start begin "Office supply request needed"
    task submit "Submit the office supply request"
    task review "Review the change comments"
  lane sup "Supervisor"
    task decide "Evaluate the request"
    xor outcome "Decision?"
  lane pur "Purchase department"
    sub quote "Make quotations"
      start qs "Start quotations"
      task collect "Collect the quotations"
      end qe "Quotations made"
    task select "Select a vendor"
    xor valid "Vendor valid in the system?"
  lane sys "System"
    task register "Register the request"
    task nrej "Send the rejection notification"
    task nchg "Send the change notification"
    task napp "Send the approval notification"
    task gen "Generate the purchase order"
    task send "Send the purchase order"
    task deliver "Receive the product and the invoice"
    end rejected "Request rejected"
    end done "Request completed"

flow begin -> submit -> register -> decide -> outcome
flow outcome -> nrej "rejected"
flow outcome -> nchg "change required"
flow outcome -> napp "approved"
flow nrej -> rejected
flow nchg -> review -> submit
flow napp -> quote -> select -> valid
flow valid -> select "no"
flow valid -> gen "yes"
flow gen -> send -> deliver -> done
flow qs -> collect -> qe
